title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Associate Certification
overview: The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Associate Certification course is designed to provide a foundational understanding of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) services and solutions. This course prepares participants for the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Associate certification exam, focusing on core OCI concepts, architecture, and management.
audience: IT professionals and beginners seeking to understand Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
Cloud architects, administrators, and developers interested in OCI fundamentals.
Individuals preparing for the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Associate certification exam.
Non-technical professionals who need a basic understanding of OCI services.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Detailed explanations of OCI services, architecture, and management tools.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises for interacting with OCI services and tools.
Case Studies: Real-world scenarios to understand OCI solutions and use cases.
Group Discussions: Collaborative sessions to explore OCI concepts and applications.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate knowledge and readiness for the certification exam.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a foundational understanding of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure services and solutions.
To prepare participants for the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Foundations Associate certification exam.
To familiarize learners with OCI architecture, pricing, and management tools.
To introduce basic concepts of OCI security, compliance, and governance.
